```{r setup, include=FALSE}
pmx_shared <- function(f) {
  root <- Sys.getenv("PMX_ROOT", "")
  cand <- c(file.path("_shared", f), file.path("..", "_shared", f),
            file.path("..", "..", "_shared", f),
            file.path("02_html", "_shared", f),
            file.path("analyses_template", "_shared", f))
  if (nzchar(root))
    cand <- c(cand, file.path(root, "_shared", f),
              file.path(root, "02_html", "_shared", f),
              file.path(root, "analyses_template", "_shared", f))
  hit <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (!length(hit))
    stop("shared fit template not found: ", f,
         "\n  looked in: ", paste(cand, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  hit[1]
}
knitr::knit_child(pmx_shared("fit_setup.Rmd"), quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r figure-layout, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(pmx_fit_caption_style)
```

```{r switches}
RUN_BOOTSTRAP <- FALSE   # non-parametric bootstrap CI (nlmixr2extra::bootstrapFit)
RUN_SCM       <- FALSE   # covariate search (nlmixr2extra::covarSearchAuto)

BOOT_NBOOT   <- 200      # replicate fits: each one is a full refit
BOOT_CI      <- 0.95     # two-sided level -> percentile CI at 2.5 % / 97.5 %
BOOT_STDERR  <- "perc"   # "perc" = percentile interval, which makes no symmetry
BOOT_STRAT   <- NULL     # optional stratification variable, e.g. "DOSE"
BOOT_RESTART <- FALSE    # TRUE discards the cache and starts the run over

SCM_SEARCH  <- "scm"     # "scm" = forward + backward, or "forward"/"backward"
SCM_PVAL    <- list(fwd = 0.05, bck = 0.01)   # pre-declared significance levels
SCM_RESTART <- FALSE     # TRUE discards the cache and starts the search over
SCM_MAP <- list(
  tvcl    = c("AGE", "BW", "SEX", "RACE"),
  tvv1    = c("BW", "SEX"),
  tve0    = c("AGE"),
  tvslope = c("AGE", "BW")
)
SCM_CAT <- c("SEX", "RACE")
```

# 1. Data Overview

```{r read-data}
df <- read.csv("pkpd_data.csv", na.strings = ".")
pk_obs <- df %>% filter(EVID == 0, DVID == 1)
pd_obs <- df %>% filter(EVID == 0, DVID == 2)

cov_tab <- df %>% distinct(ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

summary_tab <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Subjects", "Total records", "PK observations", "PD observations",
             "Dose groups (mg/kg)", "Subjects per dose group", "Median BW (kg)"),
  Value = c(
    nrow(cov_tab),
    nrow(df),
    nrow(pk_obs),
    nrow(pd_obs),
    paste(sort(unique(cov_tab$DOSE)), collapse = ", "),
    paste(sprintf("%s: n=%d", names(table(cov_tab$DOSE)),
                  as.integer(table(cov_tab$DOSE))), collapse = "; "),
    round(median(df$BW, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )
)
kable(summary_tab, caption = "Dataset Summary", align = "lc")
```

## 1.1 Covariate Summary

```{r cov-summary, results='asis'}
cov_df <- df
con_cov <- c("AGE","BW","BMI","ALB","CRCL")
cat_cov <- c("SEX","RACE","DOSE")
var_labels <- pmx_fit_covariate_labels(c(AGE="Age",BW="Body weight",BMI="BMI",
  ALB="Albumin",CRCL="Creatinine clearance",SEX="Sex",RACE="Race",DOSE="Dose level"))
cov_table <- pmx_patient_characteristics(cov_df,con_cov,cat_cov,var_labels,
  level_display=pmx_fit_level_display,id="ID",label_column="Covariates")
pmx_fit_characteristics_kable(cov_table)
```

## 1.2 PK Concentration-Time Profiles

```{r pk-spaghetti, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Individual PK concentration-time profiles"}
ggplot(pk_obs, aes(TIME, DV, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "Concentration (ng/mL)") +
  theme_bw()
```

## 1.3 PD Response-Time Profiles

```{r pd-spaghetti, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Individual PD response-time profiles"}
ggplot(pd_obs, aes(TIME, DV, group = ID)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.15, color = "darkorange") +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3, color = "darkorange") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Time (h)", y = "PD Response") +
  theme_bw()
```

## 1.4 PK-PD Relationship (Hysteresis Check)

```{r pkpd-hysteresis, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="PK–PD hysteresis plot"}
merged <- pk_obs %>%
  select(ID, TIME, DV) %>%
  rename(CONC = DV) %>%
  inner_join(
    pd_obs %>% select(ID, TIME, DV) %>% rename(RESP = DV),
    by = c("ID", "TIME")
  )

ggplot(merged, aes(CONC, RESP, group = ID)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(aes(color = TIME), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "yellow", high = "darkred") +
  labs(x = "Concentration (ng/mL)", y = "PD Response",
       color = "Time (h)") +
  theme_bw()
```

# 2. Model Fitting

```{r fit-knobs, include=FALSE}
FIT_FAM      <- "pkpd"
FIT_SEC      <- c(save = 4, boot = 5, scm = 6)
FIT_CTL      <- "base_model.ctl"
FIT_THETA    <- c("TVCL", "TVV1", "TVQ", "TVV2", "TVE0", "TVSLOPE")
FIT_ETA      <- c("ETA_CL", "ETA_V1")
FIT_REFIT    <- TRUE

FIT_ENDPOINT <- function(m) model(m, {
  cp      <- ipred
  pd_resp <- ipred2
  cp      ~ lnorm(sdPK)
  pd_resp ~ lnorm(sdPD)
}, append = TRUE)

FIT_PREP <- function(df) df %>%
  filter(!(EVID == 0 & TIME == 0 & DVID == 2)) %>%
  mutate(evid = EVID, amt = AMT, cmt = ifelse(EVID == 1, 1, NA), mdv = MDV,
         dv = DV, nmdvid = DVID, dvid = DVID, eps1 = 0, eps2 = 0) %>%
  select(ID, TIME, evid, amt, cmt, mdv, dv, nmdvid, dvid, BW, eps1, eps2)
```

```{r fit-core, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(knitr::knit_child(pmx_shared("fit_core.Rmd"), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```

# 3. Model-Predicted PK-PD Curve

```{r pkpd-curve, fig.width=9, fig.height=4, fig.cap="Model-predicted concentration–response relationship"}
conc_seq <- exp(seq(log(0.01), log(1000), length.out = 200))
pred_pd <- data.frame(
  CONC = conc_seq,
  PRED = fixef(fit)["TVE0"] + fixef(fit)["TVSLOPE"] * conc_seq
)

merged_plot <- merged %>%
  mutate(DOSE_GRP = cut(CONC, breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, Inf),
                        labels = c("Low", "Mid", "High", "Very High")))

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = merged_plot, aes(CONC, RESP), alpha = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
  geom_line(data = pred_pd, aes(CONC, PRED), color = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "Concentration (ng/mL)", y = "PD Response") +
  theme_bw()
```
